{{External|rs|rsc=Maple Shortbow|dw=Maple Shortbow}} {{Infobox Item |name = Maple shortbow |image = [[File:Maple shortbow.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A shortbow made out of Maple, still effective. |value = 400 |weight = 1.360 |exchange = Yes |id = 853 }} [[File:Maple shortbow detail.png|left|130px]] A '''maple shortbow''' is a two-handed [[Ranged weapons|Ranged weapon]] that can be created with the [[Fletching]] skill at level 50 by using a [[bow string]] on a [[maple shortbow (u)]], granting 50 [[experience]]. A [[Ranged]] level of 30 is required to wield it. The bow can use arrows up to [[adamant arrow|adamant]]. However, this bow isn't powerful enough for the use of broad arrows.
